dlentry.dd: The AI uses this skill when a request is about AI Positron itself. It reads the official AI Positron documentation and answers questions about features, setup, custom AI actions, context prompt customization, skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration. Its responses include links to the source documentation.
When editing XSLT content, the AI uses this skill to generate more accurate, error-free XSLT code suggestions.
When editing Schematron content, the AI uses this skill to generate more accurate, error-free Schematron code suggestions.
When editing XML Schema content, the AI uses this skill to generate more accurate, error-free XSD code suggestions.
When editing XSpec content, the AI uses this skill to generate more accurate, error-free XSpec code suggestions.
